summary: Iteration 3: verified team-alert email path, /casos page and swipeable testimonials carousel. Backend 12/12 pytest passed (test_contact.py). Backend logs confirm every POST /api/contact fires TWO email requests: confirmation to delivered@resend.dev returns 202 Accepted, team-alert to admin@swifttask.com.mx returns 422 undeliverable_recipient and is caught (logged as 'Team alert email failed: ... 422 unknown') without breaking the 200 response — matches the expected behavior described in the review request. Message is still saved and retrievable via GET /api/admin/messages. Frontend E2E: (1) Landing testimonials-carousel renders with 6 testimonial-card-N and 6 testimonials-dot-N; next/prev/dot-3 all mutate the Embla transform (translate3d changes verified). (2) Navbar nav-casos link navigates to /casos. (3) /casos casos-root loads with casos-global-stats, case-card-0/1/2, casos-cta and casos-back-link (back returns to /). (4) footer-link-casos also navigates to /casos. No console errors on /casos (only a benign framer-motion useScroll hydration warning). No 422 reported as bug per instructions.

issues: Console warning: 'You have defined a target options but the provided ref is not yet hydrated' — useScroll target ref defined higher up than the component; not user-visible, but should be moved into the same component or set layoutEffect:false.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: two sequential awaits on send_email inside POST /api/contact add latency (~600ms observed) to the API response. Consider firing both emails via asyncio.gather or as a fire-and-forget background task (BackgroundTasks) so the user gets the 200 faster.

server.py: TEAM_NOTIFY_EMAIL is a placeholder domain (admin@swifttask.com.mx) that will always 422. Fine for now, but log level for that specific 422 could be WARNING (not ERROR) to avoid alert noise once real monitoring is added.
CORS: allow_origins from env still defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — invalid per spec. Not exercised yet but should be tightened.
Casos.jsx has no lazy loading for case images — verify performance on slow networks (not tested here).
test_credentials: Admin password 'SwiftTask2026!' — verified working via POST /api/admin/login.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_-prefixed contact_messages inserted by test_contact.py (delivered@resend.dev).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend log grep pattern to confirm dual-email behavior: search /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log for 'New contact message from' followed by two httpx lines (POST .../email/send 202 Accepted, then 422 unknown) and 'Team alert email failed'. Frontend Embla carousel inner element is not '.embla__container' — use the element with an inline style.transform (translate3d(...)) to detect slide changes. testimonials section is far down the page; use scroll_into_view_if_needed on the element before interacting.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested features working as intended.
